integrity: Full scalar determinant and monotonicity proof supplied with exact rational supporting checker; same-model mathematical review only.
scientific_limitations: Applies to exactly three equally spaced real sites, Gaussian columns with equal outer widths and flatter center. Binary shape mask is conditional and not shown produced by any particular smoothness-indicator data. No condition-number bound, larger-grid extension, or priority exclusivity. The exact singularity example is not itself novel; the assessed result is the sharp symmetric binary-mask threshold.
title: Sharp localization threshold for a binary-mask three-site Gaussian interpolation matrix
